parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance is added to the default resource group.
